event_level_formula.simulator: Histogram bin probability mass: P_i = N_bin / N_total
event_level_formula.nsf_continuous: Continuous probability density: p(x_i | z_i, theta)
event_level_formula.nsf_simulator_compatible: Integrated flow probability: P_i = integral_bin p(x | z_i, theta) dx
event_level_formula.impact: Introduces theta-dependent scale differences as the PDF shape shifts.

support_truncation.impact: Far-tail events can have arbitrarily low density, biasing posteriors.

support_floor.impact: Zero-probability events dominate log-likelihood sum without a floor.

redshift_handling.impact: Minor differences in catalog membership grouping.

conclusions.action_required: Option A (Simulator Compatible Likelihood Mode) must be implemented for NSF to align support truncation, bin integration, and zero-probability floors.
